name: CHAB-2026: Cardiology Humanoid AI Benchmark
description: A case-matched evaluation protocol assessing multi-step clinical reasoning, guideline conformity, and patient safety profiles across four frontier large language models (GPT-5, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and DeepSeek-V3). The evaluation utilizes a frozen 80-case cardiology corpus consisting of 56 guideline-derived scenarios and 24 peer-reviewed published case reports. Primary continuous performance is analyzed via a non-parametric Friedman test (df=3) with post-hoc paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests under Holm-Bonferroni correction. The primary safety endpoint (SEV-2/SEV-3 composite error rate) is evaluated strictly via pairwise exact McNemar tests. Human reference cohorts are segregated under explicit secondary reference blocks.
